# Vendored libraries (for offline use)

Local copies so decks work without internet. Session 6 uses these; other sessions still load from CDNs.

| Folder | Library | Version | License |
|--------|---------|---------|---------|
| `reveal.js-5.1.0/` | reveal.js (core CSS/JS, notes and math plugins) | 5.1.0 | MIT |
| `katex-0.16.11/` | KaTeX (CSS, JS, auto-render, woff2 fonts) | 0.16.11 | MIT |
| `sheetjs-0.18.5/` | SheetJS `xlsx.full.min.js` (Excel import) | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 |
| `fonts/` | Source Sans 3 (latin, latin-ext) | Google Fonts | SIL OFL 1.1 |
